sqlite:
CREATE TABLE charges (
	id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	amount_usd FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE credentials (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (digest)
)


CREATE TABLE login_throttle (
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	window_start FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)


CREATE TABLE runtime (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active_job VARCHAR(64), 
	last_activity FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	controller_sandbox_id VARCHAR(100), 
	worker_sandbox_id VARCHAR(100), 
	dispatch_token VARCHAR(64), 
	dispatch_lease_until FLOAT, 
	schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE voices (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	original_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	reference_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	details JSON NOT NULL, 
	authorized BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	voice_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	options JSON NOT NULL, 
	script_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	error_message VARCHAR(300), 
	retryable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	timings JSON NOT NULL, 
	reserved_usd FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(voice_id) REFERENCES voices (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)


CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	duration FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_charges_created_at ON charges (created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_state ON jobs (state)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_voice_id ON jobs (voice_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_job_id ON artifacts (job_id)
